name: mongo-catalog-mcp
description: MCP exposing read/write access to the product catalog database

rules.instruction: deny any write operation outside working hours
allow read-only queries on the 'orders' collection

name: payments-mcp
description: MCP exposing payment processing and transaction records

rules.instruction: deny writes to 'transactions' from non-orchestrator agents
require explicit intent confirmation for refunds

name: inventory-mcp
description: MCP exposing warehouse inventory levels and stock adjustments

rules.instruction: allow stock read for all delegated agents
deny bulk stock adjustments above 1000 units
